product_metadata.title: TOTANKI 22" Pro Large Rolling Laundry Basket with Handle on Wheels (4 Colors), Foldable Laundry Hamper, Collapsible Laundry Sorter and Organizer, Tall Storage Basket Bin (Beige, Pro 22")
features: Extra Large Capacity: Upgraded 70L X-Large big laundry basket, dimension is 15.7" x 12" x 22.8" / 40cm x 31cm x 58cm, perfect size to hold large loads of laundry.
Sturdy Fabric & Breathable Cover: Eco-friendly 600D fabric oxford with lining inside for waterproof. Drawstring mesh cover keeps stuff inside laundry hamper clean and tidy.
Rolling Wheel for Easy Transportation: Laundry basket with wheels ensures easy movement, one of the wheels can be locked to make basket fix on the ground.
Foldable Design: Small volume after folding, takes little space in your house when not in use. You can put it in the drawer, save the family space greatly.
Versatile Basket & Classic Style: All the colors are suitable for any home style. Besides for storing dirty clothes, the basket can also be used to store kid's toys and other items.
